# V3 20x20 transfer atlas

> Exploratory evidence within one procedural synthetic family; not a blind Kaggle score.

## Aggregate findings

- Completion: 99.5%
- Zero-shot completion: 33.8%
- Mean transfer score: 0.5640
- Off-diagonal completion: 99.7%
- Off-diagonal mean transfer: 0.5615
- Directional asymmetry (mean absolute difference): 0.4092
- Invalid cells: 0
- Prior-level regressions: 0

Transfer score = completion x squared action efficiency x phase reuse x structural-edit retention.
The reference optimal path is two actions; phase reuse is 1.0 zero-shot, 0.85 probing, and 0.65 accommodation.
